def run(self) -> ProgressionResult:
        level = 1
        exp = 0
        gold = 0.0
        energy = 40
        battles = wins = deaths = 0
        energy_spent = energy_regenerated = 0
        exp_gained = 0
        gold_gained = 0.0
        premium_gold_gained = 0.0
        potion_ledger = PotionAffordabilityLedger()
        city_visits = full_bag_events = items_awarded = items_lost = 0
        elapsed = 0
        events = []
        initial_actor = self.provider.player_actor(self.character_class, 1)
        survival = PersistentCombatState(initial_actor.max_hp, initial_actor.max_hp, initial_actor.max_resource, initial_actor.max_resource)
        survival_service = SimulationSurvivalService(self.inventory, self.equipment)
        loot_city = SimulationLootEquipmentCityService(self.character_class, self.inventory, self.equipment, self.rng)
        meta = SimulationMetaProgressionService(self.inventory, self.equipment, self.rng)
        run_id = f"progress_{self.character_class}_l{self.target_level}_{self.profile.key}_{self.seed}"

        for day in range(1, self.max_days + 1):
            meta.start_day(day)
            # Offline interval always restores the capped 40 energy before the next daily window.
            regenerated = max(0, 40 - energy)
            energy = 40
            energy_regenerated += regenerated
            start = (day - 1) * 1440 + self.profile.start_hour * 60
            end = (day - 1) * 1440 + self.profile.end_hour * 60
            elapsed = max(elapsed, start)

            while elapsed < end and level < self.target_level:
                if energy <= 0:
                    elapsed += 5
                    if elapsed < end:
                        energy = min(40, energy + 1)
                        energy_regenerated += 1
                        healed = survival.passive_hp_regen(5)
                        if healed: events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "hp_regen", {"amount": healed, "hp": survival.hp}))
                    continue

                hp_potions = inventory_potions(self.inventory.items, HP_IDS)
                mp_potions = inventory_potions(self.inventory.items, MP_IDS)
                mana_class = self.character_class in {"mage", "priest"}
                potion = self.policy.choose_potion(survival.hp, survival.max_hp, survival.mp, survival.max_mp, mana_class, hp_potions, mp_potions)
                if potion:
                    kind = "hp" if potion.action == "use_hp_potion" else "mp"
                    item_id = int(potion.payload["item_id"])
                    maximum = survival.max_hp if kind == "hp" else survival.max_mp
                    current = survival.hp if kind == "hp" else survival.mp
                    restored = min(maximum - current, int(potion.payload["restore"]))
                    if restored > 0 and meta._consume(item_id, 1):
                        if kind == "hp": survival.hp += restored
                        else: survival.mp += restored
                        potion_ledger.record_free_use(item_id)
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "potion_used", {"source":"owned_or_dropped","kind":kind,"item_id":item_id,"restore":restored}))
                else:
                    need_hp = survival.max_hp > 0 and survival.hp / survival.max_hp < self.policy.hp_potion_threshold
                    need_mp = mana_class and survival.max_mp > 0 and survival.mp / survival.max_mp < self.policy.mp_potion_threshold
                    kind = "hp" if need_hp else "mp" if need_mp else None
                    item_id = affordable_small(kind, gold) if kind else None
                    if item_id is not None:
                        row = POTION_CATALOG[item_id]; cost = float(row["buy_price"]); gold = round(gold - cost, 2)
                        restored = min((survival.max_hp-survival.hp) if kind=="hp" else (survival.max_mp-survival.mp), int(row["restore"]))
                        if kind == "hp": survival.hp += restored
                        else: survival.mp += restored
                        potion_ledger.buy_and_use(item_id)
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "potion_purchased_and_used", {"kind":kind,"item_id":item_id,"cost":cost,"restore":restored,"gold_after":gold}))
                if survival.max_hp > 0 and survival.hp / survival.max_hp <= 0.25:
                    elapsed += 5
                    healed = survival.passive_hp_regen(5)
                    events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "pre_hunt_hp_wait", {"threshold_percent": 25, "healed": healed, "hp": survival.hp, "max_hp": survival.max_hp}))
                    continue

                available = self.provider.mobs(level)
                contract = meta.ensure_contract(level, available)
                allowed = [mob for mob in available if abs(int(mob.get("level", 1)) - int(level)) <= 1 and int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1)) <= int(level)]
                contract_target = contract.target_name if contract else ""
                selected = next((mob for mob in allowed if contract_target and str(mob.get("name", "")) == contract_target), None)
                selection_reason = "contract_target" if selected is not None else "seeded_random"
                if selected is None and allowed:
                    selected = self.rng.choice(allowed)
                if selected is None:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"production content gap: no mob for player level {level}; current max mob level={self.provider.content_max_mob_level()}")
                selected_template = selected
                selected = self.provider.resolve_encounter(level, selected_template, self.rng)
                if bool(selected.get("is_boss")):
                    selection_reason = "canonical_boss_roll"
                elif bool(selected.get("is_elite")):
                    selection_reason = "canonical_elite_roll"

                battle_seed = self.rng.randint(1, 2_147_483_647)
                result = ExactPveBattleEngine(self.root, battle_seed).run(
                    f"{run_id}_b{battles + 1}", self.character_class,
                    self.provider.player_actor(self.character_class, level, survival.hp, survival.mp),
                    self.provider.mob_actor(selected), _encounter_type(selected),
                )
                battles += 1
                energy -= 1
                energy_spent += 1
                elapsed += max(1, result.turns)

                survival.hp = result.player_hp
                survival.mp = int(result.metrics.get("player_resource", survival.mp))
                survival.restore_mp_after_combat()

                if result.winner == "player":
                    wins += 1
                    gained_exp, base_gold = self.provider.reward(level, selected, self.rng)
                    from systems.timed_exp_bonus_system import calculate_premium_combat_gold
                    gold_breakdown = calculate_premium_combat_gold(base_gold, self.premium_active)
                    gained_gold = float(gold_breakdown["final_gold"])
                    premium_gold_bonus = float(gold_breakdown["bonus_gold"])
                    exp += gained_exp
                    exp_gained += gained_exp
                    gold += gained_gold
                    gold_gained += gained_gold
                    premium_gold_gained += premium_gold_bonus
                    meta.on_victory(selected, level)
                    contract_exp = meta.claim_contract()
                    if contract_exp:
                        exp += contract_exp
                        exp_gained += contract_exp
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "contract_claim", {"exp": contract_exp, "contracts": meta.state.contracts_completed_today}))
                    if meta.claim_daily():
                        items_awarded += 8
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "daily_claim", {"potions": 3, "firius_tokens": 5}))
                    loot = loot_city.process_victory(selected)
                    items_awarded += loot.awarded
                    items_lost += loot.lost
                    full_bag_events += loot.full_bag_events
                    gold, equipment_resolution = loot_city.resolve_equipment_after_victory(gold)
                    events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "victory", {"level": level, "player_level": level, "mob": selected["name"], "mob_level": int(selected.get("level", level)), "level_delta": int(selected.get("level", level)) - int(level), "location_id": str(selected.get("location_id", self.provider.location_for_level(level))), "attack_type": str(selected.get("attack_type", "physical")), "trash_items": list(selected.get("trash_items", []) or []), "selection_reason": selection_reason, "candidate_count": len(allowed), "encounter_type": _encounter_type(selected), "battle_outcome": "victory", "battle_turns": result.turns, "exp": gained_exp, "gold": gained_gold, "base_gold": float(gold_breakdown["base_gold"]), "premium_gold_bonus": premium_gold_bonus, "premium_gold_active": self.premium_active, "loot_awarded": loot.awarded, "loot_lost": loot.lost, "equipment": loot.equipment, "loot_records": loot.records}))
                    if equipment_resolution["equipped"] or equipment_resolution["sale_records"]:
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "equipment_resolution", equipment_resolution))
                    inserted = meta.insert_best_runes(self.character_class)
                    refined = meta.refine_best()
                    if inserted or refined or meta.state.refine_attempts:
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "resource_maintenance", {"runes_inserted": inserted, "refined": bool(refined), "refine_attempts_total": meta.state.refine_attempts, "refine_successes_total": meta.state.refine_successes}))
                    transition = self.provider.apply_exp(level, exp - gained_exp, gained_exp)
                    old_level = level
                    level = transition["level"]
                    exp = transition["exp"]
                    for reached_level in range(old_level + 1, level + 1):
                        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "level_up", {"level": reached_level}))
                else:
                    deaths += 1
                    durability = survival_service.damage_on_death()
                    survival.apply_death()
                    events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "death", {"level": level, "player_level": level, "mob": selected["name"], "mob_level": int(selected.get("level", level)), "level_delta": int(selected.get("level", level)) - int(level), "location_id": str(selected.get("location_id", self.provider.location_for_level(level))), "attack_type": str(selected.get("attack_type", "physical")), "trash_items": list(selected.get("trash_items", []) or []), "selection_reason": selection_reason, "candidate_count": len(allowed), "encounter_type": _encounter_type(selected), "battle_outcome": "defeat", "battle_turns": result.turns, "hp": 1, "durability_items": durability.changed, "broken": durability.broken}))
                    elapsed += 10
                    healed = survival.passive_hp_regen(10)
                    if healed: events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "hp_regen", {"amount": healed, "hp": survival.hp}))

                equipped_durability = [item.durability for item in survival_service.equipped_items()]
                maintenance = self.policy.maintenance(equipped_durability, self.inventory.free_slots)
                if maintenance:
                    city_visits += 1
                    gold, repair = survival_service.urgent_repair(gold, self.policy.repair_threshold)
                    gold, city = loot_city.city_maintenance(gold)
                    fused = meta.fuse_available_runes()
                    inserted = meta.insert_best_runes(self.character_class)
                    refined = meta.refine_best()
                    events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "city_visit", {"reason": maintenance.reason, "free_slots": self.inventory.free_slots, "repaired": repair.repaired, "repair_cost": repair.cost, "repair_skipped": repair.skipped_for_gold, "equipped": city.equipped, "sold_items": city.sold_items, "sold_quantity": city.sold_quantity, "sale_gold": city.gold_received, "sale_records": city.records, "rune_fusions": fused, "runes_inserted": inserted, "refined": bool(refined), "guild_exp": meta.state.guild.exp}))
                    elapsed += 5
                    healed = survival.passive_hp_regen(5)
                    if healed: events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, day, "hp_regen", {"amount": healed, "hp": survival.hp}))

            if level >= self.target_level:
                days = day
                break
        else:
            days = self.max_days

        equipped_ids = {value for value in self.equipment.slots.values() if value}
        final_items = [{"simulation_item_id": item.simulation_item_id, "item_id": item.item_id, "name": item.name, "category": item.category, "rarity": item.rarity, "quantity": item.quantity, "slot_key": item.slot_key, "item_level": item.item_level, "armor_type": item.armor_type, "refine_level": item.refine_level, "durability": item.durability, "stats": dict(item.stats), "runes": [asdict(rune) for rune in item.runes], "destination": "equipped" if item.simulation_item_id in equipped_ids else "remaining"} for item in self.inventory.items]
        events.append(ProgressionEvent(elapsed, days, "simulation_final_state", {"gold": round(gold,2), "equipment_slots": dict(self.equipment.slots), "inventory": final_items, "guild_exp": meta.state.guild.exp, "refine_attempts": meta.state.refine_attempts, "refine_successes": meta.state.refine_successes, "premium_active": self.premium_active, "premium_gold_gained": round(premium_gold_gained,2), "potion_affordability": potion_ledger.to_dict(gold_gained)}))
        status = "completed" if level >= self.target_level else "max_days_reached"
        return ProgressionResult(
            run_id, self.character_class, self.target_level, level, self.profile.key, self.seed,
            days, elapsed, battles, wins, deaths, energy_spent, energy_regenerated,
            exp_gained, gold_gained, gold, city_visits, full_bag_events, items_awarded,
            items_lost, self.inventory.free_slots, events, status,
        )

def resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class):
    """Return the zero-resource basic-attack damage type for a player class.

    The resolver is intentionally class-owned rather than weapon-owned: weapon
    ranges remain part of damage calculation, while the class selects PATK/PDEF
    or MATK/MDEF routing. Unknown classes fail closed instead of silently using
    the historical physical fallback.
    """
    class_key = str(character_class or "").strip().lower()
    try:
        return BASIC_ATTACK_TYPE_BY_CLASS[class_key]
    except KeyError as error:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported character class for basic attack: {character_class!r}") from error

def init_world_chronicle_system(db_path=None):

        connection.executescript(

                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                actor_user_id INTEGER,
                actor_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
                subject_key TEXT,
                subject_name_snapshot TEXT,
                location_id TEXT,

def record_world_chronicle_event(
    event_type,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_name_snapshot,
    deduplication_key,
    *,
    subject_key=None,
    subject_name_snapshot=None,
    location_id=None,
    metadata=None,
    connection=None,
    db_path=None,
):
    event_type = str(event_type or "").strip()
    actor_name = str(actor_name_snapshot or "").strip()
    deduplication_key = str(deduplication_key or "").strip()
    if event_type not in WORLD_CHRONICLE_EVENT_TYPES:
        return {"success": False, "inserted": False, "reason": "invalid_event_type"}
    if not actor_name or not deduplication_key:
        return {"success": False, "inserted": False, "reason": "missing_required_value"}

    owns_connection = connection is None
    active_connection = connection or _connect(db_path)
    try:
        cursor = active_connection.execute(
            """
            INSERT OR IGNORE INTO world_chronicle_events (
                event_type, actor_user_id, actor_name_snapshot,
                subject_key, subject_name_snapshot, location_id,
                metadata_json, deduplication_key, created_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                event_type,
                int(actor_user_id) if actor_user_id is not None else None,
                actor_name,
                str(subject_key) if subject_key is not None else None,
                str(subject_name_snapshot) if subject_name_snapshot is not None else None,
                str(location_id) if location_id is not None else None,
                json.dumps(metadata or {}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
                deduplication_key,
                datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            ),
        )
        inserted = cursor.rowcount == 1
        if inserted:
            active_connection.execute(
                """
                DELETE FROM world_chronicle_events
                WHERE id NOT IN (
                    SELECT id
                    FROM world_chronicle_events
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                    LIMIT ?
                )
                """,
                (WORLD_CHRONICLE_RETENTION,),
            )
        if owns_connection:
            active_connection.commit()
        return {"success": True, "inserted": inserted}
    except Exception:
        if owns_connection:
            active_connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        if owns_connection:
            active_connection.close()

def main():
 assert MANA_REGEN_PERCENT_PER_FULL_MINUTE==30

 vectors={
  'fireball':({"cost_type":"mana","mana_cost_flat":8,"mana_cost_max_mp_percent":7},[20,29,50,78]),
  'thunder':({"cost_type":"mana","mana_cost_flat":15,"mana_cost_max_mp_percent":18},[46,69,123,195]),

  'flow':({"cost_type":"mana","mana_cost_flat":0,"mana_cost_max_mp_percent":0},[0,0,0,0]),
 }
 maxima=(170,300,600,1000)
 for _name,(skill,expected) in vectors.items():
  assert [calculate_mana_skill_cost(skill,m) for m in maxima]==expected
 assert calculate_mana_restore_amount(170,25)==43
 assert calculate_mana_restore_amount(170,15)==26

 assert apply_post_combat_mp_floor_value(20,170)==85

    for name in TARGETS:

        if "character_system" not in wrapper:
            fail(f"db.{name} is not a Character System wrapper")

    for name in PRESERVE:
        if len(db_defs.get(name, [])) != 1:

    if str(inspect.signature(db.set_user_mp)) != "(user_id, mp)":

            if safe(getattr(db, name), user_id) != safe(getattr(character, name), user_id):

    samples = ("", "  x  ", "11", "A B")

def main():
    for path in (DB_PATH, COMBAT_PATH, POTION_PATH, CHARACTER_PATH, DB_PY_PATH):
        if not path.is_file():
            fail(f"missing required file: {path}")

    before = fingerprint(DB_PATH)
    combat_text, combat_tree = parse(COMBAT_PATH)
    potion_text, potion_tree = parse(POTION_PATH)
    character_text, character_tree = parse(CHARACTER_PATH)
    db_text, db_tree = parse(DB_PY_PATH)

    potion_config = literal_assignment(potion_tree, "POTIONS")
    if not isinstance(potion_config, dict):
        fail("POTIONS config is not a literal dictionary")

    config_rows = {}
    for item_id in HP_IDS + MANA_IDS:
        row = potion_config.get(item_id)
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            fail(f"POTIONS missing item {item_id}")
        config_rows[item_id] = row

    build_node, build_source = function_source(
        combat_text, combat_tree, "build_combat_potion_kb"
    )
    cooldown_node, cooldown_source = function_source(
        combat_text, combat_tree, "get_potion_cooldown_turns_by_inventory_id"
    )
    use_handler_node, use_handler_source = function_source(
        combat_text, combat_tree, "use_selected_potion_in_combat"
    )
    choose_node, choose_source = function_source(
        combat_text, combat_tree, "choose_potion_in_combat"
    )
    use_node, use_source = function_source(
        potion_text, potion_tree, "use_potion_from_inventory"
    )
    resource_node, resource_source = function_source(
        character_text, character_tree, "get_character_resource_type"
    )
    mp_get_definitions = function_sources(
        character_text, character_tree, "get_user_mp"
    )
    mp_get_node, mp_get_source = mp_get_definitions[-1]
    mp_set_node, mp_set_source = function_source(
        character_text, character_tree, "set_user_mp"
    )
    spend_node, spend_source = function_source(
        db_text, db_tree, "spend_user_mp"
    )

    hp_filter_present = (
        'type_ in ["potion_hp", "potion_hp_medium"]' in build_source
        or "type_ in ['potion_hp', 'potion_hp_medium']" in build_source
    )
    mana_types_in_keyboard = (
        "potion_mp" in build_source or "potion_mp_medium" in build_source
    )
    mana_backend_blocked = (
        'potion["type"] == "mp"' in use_source
        and "Мана ще не реалізована" in use_source
    )
    cooldown_has_hp = "potion_hp" in cooldown_source
    cooldown_has_mp = "potion_mp" in cooldown_source
    handler_hp_only_result = (
        'potion_result["new_hp"]' in use_handler_source
        and 'potion_result["max_hp"]' in use_handler_source
    )
    handler_mp_result = any(
        marker in use_handler_source
        for marker in (
            'potion_result["new_mp"]',
            'potion_result["max_mp"]',
            'potion_result.get("new_mp")',
        )
    )
    combat_state_has_mp = (
        'mob["player_mp"]' in combat_text
        and 'mob["player_max_mp"]' in combat_text
    )
    mana_resource_known = 'return "mana"' in resource_source or "mana" in character_text
    mp_helpers_available = all((
        "return" in mp_get_source,
        "UPDATE users" in mp_set_source or "set_user_mp" in mp_set_source,
        "UPDATE users" in spend_source,
    ))
    no_turn_spent = "Хід не витрачено" in use_handler_source
    shared_cooldown = 'mob["potion_cooldown"]' in use_handler_source
    empty_message_hp_only = "немає зілля здоров’я" in choose_source

    # Structural result contract gap.
    current_success_keys = set()
    for node in ast.walk(use_node):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Return) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Dict):
            literal_keys = []
            for key in node.value.keys:
                if isinstance(key, ast.Constant) and isinstance(key.value, str):
                    literal_keys.append(key.value)
            if "success" in literal_keys and "new_hp" in literal_keys:
                current_success_keys.update(literal_keys)
    expected_mp_keys = {"success", "message", "restore_mp", "new_mp", "max_mp"}
    missing_mp_keys = sorted(expected_mp_keys - current_success_keys)

    uri = DB_PATH.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        columns = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)").fetchall()}
        mp_columns = sorted(columns.intersection({"mp", "max_mp", "character_class"}))
        hp_inventory = inventory_counts(conn, HP_IDS)
        mana_inventory = inventory_counts(conn, MANA_IDS)
        item_rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, name, type, category, max_stack FROM items WHERE id IN (201,202,203,204) ORDER BY id"
        ).fetchall()
        integrity = conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        conn.close()

    after = fingerprint(DB_PATH)
    if before != after:
        fail("game.db changed during read-only audit")
    if integrity != "ok":
        fail(f"database quick_check={integrity}")

    diagnosis = []
    if hp_filter_present and not mana_types_in_keyboard:
        diagnosis.append("Combat potion keyboard explicitly filters only HP potion item types.")
    if mana_backend_blocked:
        diagnosis.append("Potion backend explicitly rejects every MP potion as not implemented.")
    if handler_hp_only_result and not handler_mp_result:
        diagnosis.append("Combat callback assumes every successful potion returns HP-only keys.")
    if not cooldown_has_mp:
        diagnosis.append("Cooldown helper has no explicit MP potion mapping.")
    if empty_message_hp_only:
        diagnosis.append("Empty potion-list message mentions only health potions.")

    implementation_scope = [
        "Extend the combat potion keyboard with `potion_mp` and `potion_mp_medium` only for mana-resource classes.",
        "Implement MP restoration in `systems.potion_system.use_potion_from_inventory()` using current/max MP helpers.",
        "Return a typed result that lets the combat callback distinguish HP from MP restoration.",
        "Synchronize successful MP restoration into `mob['player_mp']` and `mob['player_max_mp']`.",
        "Keep potion use turn-free and use the existing shared stomach cooldown unless a separate balance rule is requested.",
        "Map small MP potion to 3 turns and medium MP potion to 5 turns, matching HP size tiers.",
        "Reject MP potion use at full mana without consuming the item or starting cooldown.",
        "Hide MP potions from warrior, knight, scout, and rogue combat menus.",
        "Preserve all current HP potion behavior and contracts.",
    ]

    report = [
        "# ROM 9.0.13e — Combat Mana Potion Audit",
        "",
        f"Generated: `{datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}`",
        "",
        "## Safety",
        "",
        "- Gameplay files changed: **0**",
        "- Database rows changed: **0**",
        f"- Database SHA/size/mtime unchanged: **{before == after}**",
        f"- Database quick check: **{integrity}**",
        "",
        "## Static potion definitions",
        "",
    ]
    for item_id in HP_IDS + MANA_IDS:
        report.append(f"- `{item_id}`: `{config_rows[item_id]}`")
    report.extend([
        "",
        "## Current combat UI",
        "",
        f"- HP-only keyboard filter detected: **{hp_filter_present}**",
        f"- MP item types included in keyboard: **{mana_types_in_keyboard}**",
        f"- Empty-list message is HP-only: **{empty_message_hp_only}**",
        "",
        "## Current potion backend",
        "",
        f"- MP potion definitions exist: **{all(config_rows[item_id].get('type') == 'mp' for item_id in MANA_IDS)}**",
        f"- MP use explicitly rejected: **{mana_backend_blocked}**",
        f"- Current success result keys: `{sorted(current_success_keys)}`",
        f"- Required MP result keys missing from current HP contract: `{missing_mp_keys}`",
        "",
        "## Combat callback and state",
        "",
        f"- Callback assumes HP result keys only: **{handler_hp_only_result}**",
        f"- Callback handles MP result keys: **{handler_mp_result}**",
        f"- Combat state already stores player MP/max MP: **{combat_state_has_mp}**",
        f"- Potion use currently spends no combat turn: **{no_turn_spent}**",
        f"- Shared potion cooldown state exists: **{shared_cooldown}**",
        f"- Cooldown helper handles HP potions: **{cooldown_has_hp}**",
        f"- Cooldown helper handles MP potions: **{cooldown_has_mp}**",
        "",
        "## Character/MP infrastructure",
        "",
        f"- Mana resource is defined: **{mana_resource_known}**",
        f"- MP get/set/spend helpers are available: **{mp_helpers_available}**",
        f"- `get_user_mp()` definitions in Character System: **{len(mp_get_definitions)}** at lines `{[node.lineno for node, _source in mp_get_definitions]}`",
        "- Runtime audit selected the last effective `get_user_mp()` definition, matching Python name binding.",
        f"- Relevant user columns: `{mp_columns}`",
        "",
        "## Real database context",
        "",
        f"- Static potion rows: `{[tuple(row) for row in item_rows]}`",
        f"- HP potion inventory context: `{hp_inventory}`",
        f"- MP potion inventory context: `{mana_inventory}`",
        "",
        "## Diagnosis",
        "",
    ])
    for finding in diagnosis:
        report.append(f"- {finding}")
    report.extend([
        "",
        "## Implementation scope for the next patch",
        "",
    ])
    for index, item in enumerate(implementation_scope, start=1):
        report.append(f"{index}. {item}")
    report.extend([
        "",
        "## Conclusion",
        "",
        "MP potions are fully defined as static items, and the Character/Combat systems already maintain MP state. However, combat support is incomplete in three separate layers: the potion-selection keyboard excludes MP types, the potion backend explicitly rejects MP restoration, and the combat callback assumes an HP-only success payload.",
        "",
        "Suggested next patch: `patch_9_0_13f_combat_mana_potion_implementation.py`",
        "",
    ])
    REPORT.write_text("\n".join(report), encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] Combat Mana Potion audit")
    print("- mana potion static definitions: 2")
    print(f"- combat keyboard includes mana potions: {mana_types_in_keyboard}")
    print(f"- potion backend supports mana restore: {not mana_backend_blocked}")
    print(f"- combat callback supports MP result payload: {handler_mp_result}")
    print(f"- combat MP state already available: {combat_state_has_mp}")
    print(f"- MP helpers available: {mp_helpers_available}")
    print(f"- get_user_mp definitions: {len(mp_get_definitions)} (last effective definition audited)")
    print(f"- shared cooldown and no-turn use: {shared_cooldown and no_turn_spent}")
    print(f"- MP potion inventory rows: {sum(row['stacks'] for row in mana_inventory)}")
    print("- database mutations: 0")
    print("- diagnosis: UI + backend + callback implementation gap")
    print(f"- report: {REPORT}")

def main():
    db_text, db_defs = parse(ROOT / "db.py")
    system_text, system_defs = parse(ROOT / "systems" / "equipment_system.py")

    import db
    from systems import equipment_system as equipment

    for name in TARGETS:
        if len(db_defs.get(name, [])) != 1:
            fail(f"db.py {name}: definitions={len(db_defs.get(name, []))}, expected 1")
        if not system_defs.get(name):
            fail(f"equipment_system.py missing {name}")
        wrapper = ast.get_source_segment(db_text, db_defs[name][0]) or ""
        system_final = ast.get_source_segment(system_text, system_defs[name][-1]) or ""
        if "equipment_system" not in wrapper:
            fail(f"db.{name} is not an Equipment System wrapper")
        if "_call_legacy" in system_final:
            fail(f"final equipment_system.{name} still calls _call_legacy")

    repair_cases = 0
    for durability in (-10, 0, 1, 50, 99, 100, 120, None):
        for rarity in ("common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic", None):
            public = safe(db.calculate_repair_cost, durability, rarity)
            direct = safe(equipment.calculate_repair_cost, durability, rarity)
            if public != direct:
                fail(f"repair-cost mismatch: durability={durability}, rarity={rarity}")
            repair_cases += 1

    missing_uid = -987654321
    missing_iid = -987654322
    before_users = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (missing_uid,)
    ).fetchone()[0]
    before_inventory = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE id=? OR user_id=?",
        (missing_iid, missing_uid),
    ).fetchone()[0]

    protected_cases = (
        ("equip_inventory_item", (missing_uid, missing_iid), {}),
        ("unequip_inventory_item", (missing_uid, missing_iid), {}),
        ("unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change", (missing_uid,), {}),
        ("repair_equipped_item", (missing_uid, missing_iid), {}),
        ("repair_all_equipped", (missing_uid,), {}),
        ("damage_equipped_items_on_death", (missing_uid,), {}),
        ("sell_inventory_item_to_trader", (missing_uid, missing_iid), {}),
        ("buy_item_for_gold", (missing_uid, missing_iid, 10.0), {}),
        ("buy_common_equipment_from_trader", (missing_uid, "__invalid_slot__"), {}),
    )
    protected = 0
    for name, args, kwargs in protected_cases:
        public = safe(getattr(db, name), *args, **kwargs)
        direct = safe(getattr(equipment, name), *args, **kwargs)
        if public != direct:
            fail(f"protected-path mismatch {name}: public={public!r}, direct={direct!r}")
        protected += 1

    after_users = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (missing_uid,)
    ).fetchone()[0]
    after_inventory = db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE id=? OR user_id=?",
        (missing_iid, missing_uid),
    ).fetchone()[0]
    if (before_users, before_inventory) != (after_users, after_inventory):

    md=f"""# Stage 18.22: Inline Map and Persistent Travel — Full Documentation

## Closure

- **Final status:** {status}
- **Closure stage:** 18.22.4
- **Production feature commits:** `d494d9511f53fa13e871932e08213fa4a0d9681d`, `b8a1975f41c631e1f36c027b2b36e97631e429a6`, `571036d9b15813e65e5f45487ac324a4d057b548`
- **Manual acceptance:** PASS
- **Database quick check:** `{quick}`
- **Foreign-key violations:** `{len(foreign)}`
- **WAL/SHM manipulation:** none

## Purpose

Stage 18.22 replaces immediate ReplyKeyboard location switching with an authoritative inline world map and persistent, cancellable, server-timed travel. City is a real world node, external locations remain huntable zones, and only adjacent nodes are visible and reachable.

## Canonical world graph

```text
🏙️ city
   ↕ 60 seconds
🌿 start_path
   ↕ 60 seconds
🌲 dark_forest
   ↕ future location
```

Rules:

- `city` is non-huntable.
- `start_path` and `dark_forest` are external huntable locations.
- Every current edge is bidirectional and takes exactly 60 seconds.
- Non-neighbor nodes are hidden and rejected by the domain.
- A locked adjacent external location is visible but cannot start travel.
- `dark_forest` uses the existing level-6 unlock policy.
- A future location must be added to `WORLD_NODES` and to both sides of a symmetric edge.

## User interface

### Map mode

Opening `🗺️ Мапа` replaces the persistent keyboard with one button:

```text
🔽 Згорнути мапу
```

Navigation is inline. The available buttons are generated from the current authoritative node.

### City

```text
🚶 Вирушити у Початок Шляху
👥 Гравці локації
```

### Start Path

```text
🏙️ Повернутися у Місто
🚶 Вирушити у Темний Бір
👥 Гравці локації
```

### Dark Forest

```text
🌿 Повернутися у Початок Шляху
👥 Гравці локації
```

A future forward button is absent until the future node exists.

### Active travel

```text
🔄 Оновити
❌ Скасувати подорож
```

Refresh re-reads the authoritative row and recalculates remaining time from the unchanged `arrival_at`. Refresh does not create a row, change revision, or extend travel.

## Persistent data model

Table: `location_travels`

Columns:

```text
id
user_id
from_node
to_node
status
revision
started_at
arrival_at
cancelled_at
completed_at
created_at
updated_at
```

Statuses:

```text
active
arrived
cancelled
failed
```

Database invariants:

- One partial unique index permits at most one active travel per user.
- `from_node` cannot equal `to_node`.
- A travel row references `users.user_id`.
- Historical terminal rows remain available for audit.
- Migration owner: `049_persistent_location_travel.py`.

## Transaction semantics

### Start

`start_travel` validates the user, current node, destination, adjacency, level unlock, busy state, and absence of another active travel. It persists `started_at` and `arrival_at` but does not change `users.current_location`.

### Cancel

Cancellation succeeds only while status is active and server time is before `arrival_at`. Revision can be checked by the callback. The first terminal claim wins.

### Arrival

Arrival uses one transaction to claim the active row as `arrived` and update `users.current_location` from `from_node` to `to_node`. If the source node changed unexpectedly, the travel is marked `failed` instead of moving the player.

### Restart recovery

Startup recovery completes only overdue active travel rows. The original `arrival_at` is preserved. A background worker processes later due rows. Telegram notification occurs after the authoritative database commit and cannot roll back the location.

## Location context and keyboards

`systems/location_context_system.py` resolves UI context from authoritative state:

```text
active travel → map_kb
city          → city_kb
external node → main_kb
invalid node  → map_kb, fail-closed
```

This resolver is used after trade cancellation, trade completion, and terminal trade-input recovery. Each participant receives a keyboard based on that participant's own location.

## Guards

During active travel, the feature blocks incompatible operations before mutation:

- PvE hunting and energy consumption
- PvP duel request and acceptance
- Direct trade request and acceptance
- City actions and NPC routes
- A second travel

Travel start is also blocked while the player has an active PvE or player-interaction state.

City hunting is explicitly rejected before energy consumption or mob generation. The legacy external-location fallback must not convert `city` into `start_path`. Look Around in City renders City content and `city_kb`.

## Player discovery

`👥 Гравці локації` is an inline map action in City and external locations. It reuses the canonical same-location online presence query. The return callback edits the same message back to the current authoritative map.

## Starting and migration policy

- New characters start in `city`.
- DEV reset starts in `city`.
- Existing valid users were preserved in their existing locations during Stage 18.22.1.
- Class change and ordinary restart do not reset location.

## Testing

Automated coverage includes:

- graph symmetry and known-node validation
- temporary-DB start, cancel, arrival and recovery paths
- 59-second rejection and 60-second arrival
- one-active-travel uniqueness
- level lock and non-neighbor rejection
- inline callback and collapse-keyboard contracts
- refresh and stale callback ownership
- City players
- PvE, trade, PvP and City guards
- context-aware trade recovery
- City hunt fail-closed behavior
- runtime imports
- SQLite quick check and foreign keys

Manual acceptance verified the complete UI flow, travel, cancellation, arrival, refresh, City player list, context-aware trade recovery and the recovered hunt guard.

## Known nuances

- Telegram may retain old reply buttons visually; server-side guards remain authoritative.
- Arrival notification failure does not undo committed arrival.
- Cancellation at the same moment as arrival is resolved by the first successful terminal database claim.
- Unknown location state intentionally exposes no hunting keyboard.

## Closure result

Stage 18.22 is accepted as complete when this audit reports PASS and the closure commit is created.
"""

- **WAL/SHM manipulation:** none

## Purpose

Stage 18.22 replaces immediate ReplyKeyboard location switching with an authoritative inline world map and persistent, cancellable, server-timed travel. City is a real world node, external locations remain huntable zones, and only adjacent nodes are visible and reachable.

## Canonical world graph

```text
🏙️ city
   ↕ 60 seconds
🌿 start_path
   ↕ 60 seconds
🌲 dark_forest
   ↕ future location
```

Rules:

- `city` is non-huntable.
- `start_path` and `dark_forest` are external huntable locations.
- Every current edge is bidirectional and takes exactly 60 seconds.
- Non-neighbor nodes are hidden and rejected by the domain.
- A locked adjacent external location is visible but cannot start travel.
- `dark_forest` uses the existing level-6 unlock policy.
- A future location must be added to `WORLD_NODES` and to both sides of a symmetric edge.

## User interface

### Map mode

Opening `🗺️ Мапа` replaces the persistent keyboard with one button:

```text
🔽 Згорнути мапу
```

Navigation is inline. The available buttons are generated from the current authoritative node.

### City

```text
🚶 Вирушити у Початок Шляху
👥 Гравці локації
```

### Start Path

```text
🏙️ Повернутися у Місто
🚶 Вирушити у Темний Бір
👥 Гравці локації
```

### Dark Forest

```text
🌿 Повернутися у Початок Шляху
👥 Гравці локації
```

A future forward button is absent until the future node exists.

### Active travel

```text
🔄 Оновити
❌ Скасувати подорож
```

Refresh re-reads the authoritative row and recalculates remaining time from the unchanged `arrival_at`. Refresh does not create a row, change revision, or extend travel.

## Persistent data model

Table: `location_travels`

Columns:

```text
id
user_id
from_node
to_node
status
revision
started_at
arrival_at
cancelled_at
completed_at
created_at
updated_at
```

Statuses:

```text
active
arrived
cancelled
failed
```

Database invariants:

- One partial unique index permits at most one active travel per user.
- `from_node` cannot equal `to_node`.
- A travel row references `users.user_id`.
- Historical terminal rows remain available for audit.
- Migration owner: `049_persistent_location_travel.py`.

## Transaction semantics

### Start

`start_travel` validates the user, current node, destination, adjacency, level unlock, busy state, and absence of another active travel. It persists `started_at` and `arrival_at` but does not change `users.current_location`.

### Cancel

Cancellation succeeds only while status is active and server time is before `arrival_at`. Revision can be checked by the callback. The first terminal claim wins.

### Arrival

Arrival uses one transaction to claim the active row as `arrived` and update `users.current_location` from `from_node` to `to_node`. If the source node changed unexpectedly, the travel is marked `failed` instead of moving the player.

### Restart recovery

Startup recovery completes only overdue active travel rows. The original `arrival_at` is preserved. A background worker processes later due rows. Telegram notification occurs after the authoritative database commit and cannot roll back the location.

## Location context and keyboards

`systems/location_context_system.py` resolves UI context from authoritative state:

```text
active travel → map_kb
city          → city_kb
external node → main_kb
invalid node  → map_kb, fail-closed
```

This resolver is used after trade cancellation, trade completion, and terminal trade-input recovery. Each participant receives a keyboard based on that participant's own location.

## Guards

During active travel, the feature blocks incompatible operations before mutation:

- PvE hunting and energy consumption
- PvP duel request and acceptance
- Direct trade request and acceptance
- City actions and NPC routes
- A second travel

Travel start is also blocked while the player has an active PvE or player-interaction state.

City hunting is explicitly rejected before energy consumption or mob generation. The legacy external-location fallback must not convert `city` into `start_path`. Look Around in City renders City content and `city_kb`.

## Player discovery

`👥 Гравці локації` is an inline map action in City and external locations. It reuses the canonical same-location online presence query. The return callback edits the same message back to the current authoritative map.

## Starting and migration policy

- New characters start in `city`.
- DEV reset starts in `city`.
- Existing valid users were preserved in their existing locations during Stage 18.22.1.
- Class change and ordinary restart do not reset location.

## Testing

Automated coverage includes:

- graph symmetry and known-node validation
- temporary-DB start, cancel, arrival and recovery paths
- 59-second rejection and 60-second arrival
- one-active-travel uniqueness
- level lock and non-neighbor rejection
- inline callback and collapse-keyboard contracts
- refresh and stale callback ownership
- City players
- PvE, trade, PvP and City guards
- context-aware trade recovery
- City hunt fail-closed behavior
- runtime imports
- SQLite quick check and foreign keys

Manual acceptance verified the complete UI flow, travel, cancellation, arrival, refresh, City player list, context-aware trade recovery and the recovered hunt guard.

## Known nuances

- Telegram may retain old reply buttons visually; server-side guards remain authoritative.
- Arrival notification failure does not undo committed arrival.
- Cancellation at the same moment as arrival is resolved by the first successful terminal database claim.
- Unknown location state intentionally exposes no hunting keyboard.

## Closure result

Stage 18.22 is accepted as complete when this audit reports PASS and the closure commit is created.

## Canonical principle

PvP uses the current PvE class skill catalog one-to-one. PvP V1 does not create separate skill costs, cooldowns, damage multipliers, effect durations or duplicate skill definitions.

## Central PvP modifiers

```python
PVP_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.00
PVP_HEALING_MULTIPLIER = 1.00
PVP_SHIELD_MULTIPLIER = 1.00
PVP_DEBUFF_MULTIPLIER = 1.00
```

## Entry and request

- A duel can be proposed only to an online player in the same location.
- Self-duel is forbidden.
- Both players must be outside PvE combat and not busy in trade, duel or another blocking activity.
- The existing interaction request and activity-session architecture should be reused.

## Isolated duel state

- Production HP, MP, exploration energy, durability, active PvE effects and cooldowns are not mutated by the duel.
- Duel-local HP starts at 100%.
- Duel-local MP starts at 100% for mana classes.
- Rage starts at 0.
- Combat Energy starts at 100.
- Combo starts at 0.
- Cooldowns start at 0.
- Active effects start empty.
- On completion, cancellation, timeout or restart recovery, production state remains unchanged.

## Round contract

- Both participants choose independently.
- Action timeout is 20 seconds.
- Timeout produces `afk_skip`, never an automatic basic attack.
- Stun produces `stunned_skip` and does not increment AFK.
- Five consecutive AFK skips cause defeat.
- If both reach the AFK limit in the same round, the result is a technical draw.
- Maximum duration is 50 rounds.
- At round limit, higher HP percentage wins; equal HP percentage is a draw.

## Resolution phases

1. Start-of-round DoT and HoT.
2. Duration and cooldown updates.
3. Terminal check after periodic effects.
4. Stun state.
5. Action collection.
6. Revision, actor, resource, combo and cooldown validation.
7. Defensive preparation, including shield, self-buff and cleanse.
8. Offensive calculations from a round-start snapshot.
9. Atomic application of both results.
10. Terminal result and next-round creation.

## Effects

- A stun applied in round N affects round N+1 and does not cancel an already chosen action in round N.
- Cleanse removes only debuffs that existed before simultaneous action resolution; it does not remove stun.
- A debuff applied simultaneously in the same round remains.
- DoT ticks do not roll critical hits.
- Reapplying the same DoT or HoT replaces power and duration; it does not stack or extend them.
- Simultaneous lethal results produce a draw.

## Items, rewards and penalties

- HP and MP potions are unavailable.
- No EXP, gold, loot, guild progress or achievements are awarded in V1.
- No item loss, gold loss, durability loss or death penalty occurs.
- Exploration energy is not consumed.

## Persistence and safety

- PvP battle state must be persisted in SQLite, not only in Python memory.
- Every callback carries battle ID, round number, revision and actor ownership.
- Stale callbacks do not mutate state.
- Round resolution is atomically claimed by one worker.
- Restart recovery restores timers or resolves expired rounds as AFK according to persisted deadlines.

def main() -> None:
    findings: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    before = {name: file_state(ROOT / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    skill_catalog = inspect_skill_catalog(findings)
    architecture = inspect_architecture()
    database = inspect_database(findings)
    existing_pvp_modules = inspect_existing_pvp_modules()

    if skill_catalog.get("total_skills") != 18:
        findings.append({"severity": "BLOCKER", "code": "skill_total", "message": f"Expected 18 skills, found {skill_catalog.get('total_skills')}"})
    if not architecture["tokens"].get("duel"):
        findings.append({"severity": "REVIEW", "code": "duel_architecture_token", "message": "У Python-коді не знайдено токен duel; Stage 14.1 має додати або уточнити інтеграційний шлях"})
    if database.get("pvp_tables"):
        findings.append({"severity": "INFO", "code": "existing_pvp_tables", "message": f"Existing PvP/duel tables: {database['pvp_tables']}"})
    else:
        findings.append({"severity": "INFO", "code": "pvp_tables_pending", "message": "Persistent PvP tables ще не створені; очікувано до Stage 14.1.0"})

    blocker_count = sum(item["severity"] == "BLOCKER" for item in findings)
    review_count = sum(item["severity"] == "REVIEW" for item in findings)
    verdict = "FAIL" if blocker_count else ("REVIEW" if review_count else "PASS")
    result = {
        "schema": "rom.pvp.architecture.skill_parity.audit.v1",
        "version": "14.0.0",
        "generated_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "verdict": verdict,
        "findings": findings,
        "skill_catalog": skill_catalog,
        "approved_rules": APPROVED_RULES,
        "pvp_multipliers": PVP_MULTIPLIERS,
        "architecture": architecture,
        "database": database,
        "existing_pvp_modules": existing_pvp_modules,
        "gameplay_mutations": 0,
        "database_writes": 0,
    }
    write_outputs(result)
    after = {name: file_state(ROOT / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    if before != after:
        raise RuntimeError("game.db or game.db-wal changed during read-only PvP audit")

    print("[OK] PvP architecture, skill parity and specification audit")
    print(f"- verdict: {verdict}")
    print(f"- findings: {len(findings)}")
    print(f"- classes: {len(skill_catalog.get('classes', {}))}/6")
    print(f"- skills: {skill_catalog.get('total_skills', 0)}/18")
    print("- PvE skill catalog reused one-to-one: YES")
    print("- separate PvP skill overrides: NO")
    print("- PvP multipliers damage/healing/shield/debuff: 1.00/1.00/1.00/1.00")
    print("- gameplay mutations: 0")
    print("- database writes: 0")
    print("- game.db/WAL unchanged: YES")
    for item in findings:
        print(f"  [{item['severity']}] {item['code']}: {item['message']}")
    if verdict == "FAIL":
        raise SystemExit(2)

def main():
    db_text = DB_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    readiness_text = READINESS_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(db_text, filename=str(DB_PATH))

    if REMOVED_CAPTURE in db_text:
        fail("unused regen capture is still present")
    if PRESERVED_MIGRATION not in db_text:
        fail("migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots was removed or renamed")
    if EXPECTED_PATTERN not in readiness_text:
        fail("readiness regex was not updated to the identifier-boundary pattern")

    matches = sorted(set(re.compile(EXPECTED_PATTERN).findall(db_text)))
    if matches:
        fail(f"real legacy identifiers remain: {matches}")

    regen_defs = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
        and node.name == "process_passive_regeneration"
    ]
    if not regen_defs:
        fail("process_passive_regeneration is missing")
    final_regen = ast.get_source_segment(db_text, regen_defs[-1]) or ""
    if "regen_system" not in final_regen:
        fail("final process_passive_regeneration does not delegate to regen_system")

    migration_defs = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
        and node.name == PRESERVED_MIGRATION
    ]
    if len(migration_defs) != 1:
        fail(f"{PRESERVED_MIGRATION} definitions={len(migration_defs)}, expected 1")

    report = [
        "# ROM 9.0.12i4e - Residual Legacy References Cleanup",
        "",
        "## Result",
        "",
        "- Unused regen compatibility capture removed: yes",
        "- Readiness regex identifier boundary fixed: yes",
        "- `migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots` preserved: yes",
        "- Real `_legacy_*` identifiers remaining in `db.py`: 0",
        "- Final `process_passive_regeneration` delegates to `systems.regen_system`: yes",
        "- Database mutations performed by this verification: 0",
        "",
        "## Expected readiness",
        "",
        "- `legacy_refs`: 0",
        "- `unsafe_delete`: 0",
        "",
    ]

    print("- real legacy identifiers: 0")
    print("- unused regen capture: removed")
    print("- readiness regex boundary: fixed")
    print("- migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots preserved: yes")

def main():
    for rel in REQUIRED_FILES:
        if not (ROOT / rel).is_file():
            fail(f"missing required file: {rel}")
    if not DB_PATH.is_file():
        fail("missing game.db")

    file_before = fingerprint(DB_PATH)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        logical_before = logical_snapshot(conn)
        quick_check = conn.execute("PRAGMA quick_check").fetchone()[0]
        tables = {
            row[0] for row in conn.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
            ).fetchall()
        }
        schema = {
            table: table_columns(conn, table)
            for table in sorted(tables)

def build_policy_md():
    return """# ROM Simulation MVP Policy Specification 13.0.0

## Статус

Це затверджена стартова policy-специфікація для PvE та progression simulator. PvP не входить у MVP і відкладається до появи production PvP ruleset.

## Безпека

- Симулятор не змінює `game.db`, реальних users, inventory, guilds або trade.
- Усі simulation runs використовують `SimulationState` у пам'яті або окремий тимчасовий fixture.
- RNG обов'язково seeded і записується у звіт.
- Production та simulation повинні використовувати спільні pure rules. Формули не копіюються в handlers.

## Inventory

- Production baseline: 40 комірок.
- Experiment: 60 комірок.
- Capacity передається через config, а не hardcode усередині engine.
- Reserve slots policy: 2.
- Один generated equipment instance займає одну комірку.
- Один stack займає одну комірку; stack merge можливий навіть при повній сумці, поки `quantity < max_stack`.
- При необхідності нового row і повній сумці drop втрачається або reward не видається відповідно до production contract.
- Метрики: full bag events, forced city returns, lost drops, lost value, average free slots, utilization.

## Профілі часу

- Casual: 18:00-21:00.
- Regular: 17:00-23:00.
- Hardcore: 09:00-23:00.
- Energy max: 40.
- Regeneration: +1 кожні 5 хвилин до максимуму.
- Усередині active window персонаж відновлює активність після regeneration tick; поза вікном лише минає час і відновлюються ресурси.

## Моби й локації

- Доступні лише unlocked locations.
- Пул мобів: рівень гравця -1, рівень гравця, рівень гравця +1.
- Active contract target має пріоритет, якщо target доступний.
- Використовувати чинний runtime selector або винесене з нього pure rule.
- Боси обробляються окремою policy, а не як випадковий normal mob.

## Зілля

- HP potion: `current_hp / max_hp < 0.30`.
- MP potion: `current_mp / max_mp < 0.25`, лише mana-класи.
- Ураховувати production cooldown.
- Обирати найменше доступне зілля, достатнє для корисного відновлення; fallback на наступне доступне.

## Ремонт

- Плановий ремонт під час city visit.
- Термінове повернення до міста, якщо будь-яка активна річ має `durability < 10`.
- Перед ремонтом продати trash і непотрібне/несумісне спорядження.
- Repair metrics: count, total cost, downtime, restored score.

## Екіпірування

1. Несумісний із класом предмет продається.
2. Порожній сумісний слот заповнюється.
3. Зайнятий слот порівнюється через class-aware effective score.
4. Рідкість не перемагає автоматично: білий предмет вищого рівня може бути кращим за синій нижчого рівня.
5. Score враховує relevant stats, damage, PDEF/MDEF, refine, durability, inserted runes і доступні socket opportunities.
6. Дворучна зброя порівнюється із сумою current main-hand + off-hand.
7. Одноручна зброя після дворучної оцінюється разом із найкращим доступним compatible off-hand.
8. Ваги класів є simulation policy і мають калібруватися через PvE результати.

## Combat action policy

MVP policy: `balanced`.

Пріоритет:
1. survival heal/shield, якщо прогнозується смерть;
2. HP potion за порогом;
3. MP potion за порогом;
4. control/defense у небезпечному бою;
5. skill, який завершує бій;
6. class finisher за оптимального ресурсу;
7. найкраща доступна offensive skill;
8. basic attack.

Майбутні policies: `safe`, `balanced`, `aggressive`.

## Acceptance baseline

`/dev_progress_sim warrior 20 regular` у режимі EXACT має завершити progression 1-20, створити JSON/Markdown звіт і не змінити real DB. Звіт охоплює бої, час, енергію, EXP, gold, deaths, loot, repair, contracts, daily, runes, fusion, refine, guild contribution, final equipment і final stats.
"""

def build_architecture_md(result):
    s = result["summary"]
    module_rows = []
    for mod in result["modules"]:
        counts = Counter()
        for f in mod["functions"]:
            counts.update(f["classification"])
        module_rows.append(
            f"| `{mod['module']}` | {len(mod['functions'])} | {counts['PURE_CANDIDATE']} | "
            f"{counts['READ_ONLY_DB']} | {counts['MUTATING_DB']} | {counts['GLOBAL_RNG_DEPENDENT']} | "
            f"{counts['TIME_DEPENDENT']} | {counts['TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT'] + counts['TELEGRAM_MODULE']} |"
        )
    top_adapters = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "ADAPTER_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    top_rng = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    top_time = [f for m in result["modules"] for f in m["functions"] if "CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED" in f["classification"]]
    module_scope = [x for m in result["modules"] for x in ({"module": m["module"], **e} for e in m["module_scope_calls"])]
    lines = [
        "# Simulation Architecture & Purity Audit 13.0.0", "",
        f"Generated: `{result['generated_at']}`", "",
        f"Verdict: **{result['verdict']}**", "",
        "## Executive summary", "",
        f"- Target modules found: **{s['modules_found']} / {s['modules_expected']}**.",
        f"- Functions analyzed: **{s['functions']}**.",
        f"- Pure candidates: **{s['pure_candidates']}**.",
        f"- Safe for direct EXACT use after parity tests: **{s['safe_exact']}**.",
        f"- Adapter required: **{s['adapter_required']}**.",
        f"- RNG injection required: **{s['rng_injection_required']}**.",
        f"- Clock injection required: **{s['clock_injection_required']}**.",
        f"- Missing modules: **{len(result['missing_modules'])}**.", "",
        "## Classification", "",
        "| Module | Functions | Pure | Read DB | Write DB | RNG | Time | Telegram |",
        "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
        *module_rows, "",
        "## Architecture findings", "",
        "1. Production domain is not uniformly pure. A substantial part of behavior is tied to SQLite, global RNG, wall-clock time, or legacy facade calls.",
        "2. The simulation engine must own state, clock, RNG and metrics. It must not create real users in `game.db`.",
        "3. Mathematical rules and selectors should be extracted or wrapped as pure functions and used by both production and simulation.",
        "4. DEV Telegram handlers must only validate commands, enqueue/run simulations and return compact summaries plus report files.",
        "5. PvP is explicitly deferred until production PvP rules exist.", "",
        "## Highest-priority adapters", "",
    ]
    for f in top_adapters[:80]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()` lines {f['line_range'][0]}-{f['line_range'][1]}: {f['recommended_action']}")
    lines += ["", "## Seeded RNG candidates", ""]
    for f in top_rng[:60]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()`")
    lines += ["", "## SimulationClock candidates", ""]
    for f in top_time[:60]:
        lines.append(f"- `{f['module']}::{f['function']}()`")
    lines += ["", "## Module-scope calls requiring caution", ""]
    if module_scope:
        for e in module_scope[:100]:
            lines.append(f"- `{e['module']}` line {e['line']}: `{e['call']}()`")
    else:
        lines.append("- No significant module-scope calls detected by the static heuristic.")
    lines += ["", "## Inventory capacity", "",
        "- Current production baseline discovered/expected: 40 slots.",
        "- Experimental scenario: 60 slots.",
        "- Simulator config must support arbitrary capacity and reserve slots.",
        "- Capacity analysis must distinguish stack merge from creating a new inventory row.", "",
        "## Limitations of this audit", "",
        "- Static AST classification is conservative and may mark facade functions as adapter-required even when a lower-level pure helper exists.",
        "- Dynamic imports, aliases and SQL assembled at runtime require manual review.",
        "- A function marked PURE_CANDIDATE still requires parity tests against production behavior before use.",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

def roadmap(result):
    s = result["summary"]
    complexity = "high" if s["adapter_required"] > max(25, s["functions"] * 0.20) else "medium"
    estimated = 9 if complexity == "high" else 7
    return f"""# Simulation implementation roadmap after audit 13.0.0

## Preliminary estimate

Static result indicates **{complexity} integration complexity**. Preliminary implementation estimate: **{estimated} core stages**, excluding PvP and optional optimization stages. This is an audit-based estimate and should be finalized after reviewing the generated callability matrix.

## Proposed stages

1. **13.1 Simulation foundation**: dataclasses/models, SimulationState, SimulationClock, seeded RNG, config, metrics, report serialization.
2. **13.2 Canonical pure rules and parity layer**: extract/wrap damage, crit, dodge, reward, repair, refine, compatibility and capacity rules; parity tests against production.
3. **13.3 Exact single-battle PvE engine**: normal/elite/boss, skills, cooldowns, class resources, potions, durability, deterministic seeds.
4. **13.4 Drop and inventory simulation**: central drop system, stack plans, 40/60 capacity, lost loot, city return, sell rules.
5. **13.5 Behavior policy engine**: equipment score, 1H/2H comparison, potion/repair/mob/skill policies, rune insertion/fusion/refine.
6. **13.6 Progression MVP**: level path and progress simulation, active windows, energy, regen, contracts, daily, guild contribution.
7. **13.7 Analytics and comparison**: PvE class balance, progression walls, loot acquisition, rune completion, 40-vs-60 capacity.
8. **13.8 Economy and population**: inflation, guild cohorts, lifecycle checkpoints, FAST-mode calibration against EXACT.
9. **13.9 RNG and patch regression**: baseline/current snapshots, same-seed comparison, lucky/average/unlucky percentiles.

## Deferred

- `systems/pvp_simulator.py`, `/dev_pvp`, `/dev_pvp_all` until production PvP exists.
- Player-facing trade history and PvP implementation are outside this analytics stage.

## Quality gates for every stage

- Real `game.db` SHA-256 unchanged.
- No real user, inventory or guild mutations.
- Seed and config fingerprint recorded.
- Own smoke test plus core regression suite.
- Exact behavior parity tests where a production rule is reused.
- Manual game check only for Telegram DEV handler/UX stages.
"""

def main():
    root = root_dir()
    before = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    modules = []
    missing = []
    syntax_errors = []
    for rel in TARGET_MODULES:
        path = root / rel
        if not path.exists():
            missing.append(rel)
            continue
        try:
            modules.append(analyze_module(path, rel))
        except SyntaxError as error:
            syntax_errors.append({"module": rel, "error": str(error)})

    all_functions = [f for m in modules for f in m["functions"]]
    counts = Counter()
    for f in all_functions:
        counts.update(f["classification"])
    summary = {
        "modules_expected": len(TARGET_MODULES),
        "modules_found": len(modules),
        "functions": len(all_functions),
        "pure_candidates": counts["PURE_CANDIDATE"],
        "safe_exact": sum(1 for f in all_functions if f["safe_for_exact_simulation"]),
        "adapter_required": counts["ADAPTER_REQUIRED"],
        "rng_injection_required": counts["RNG_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "clock_injection_required": counts["CLOCK_INJECTION_REQUIRED"],
        "read_only_db": counts["READ_ONLY_DB"],
        "mutating_db": counts["MUTATING_DB"],
        "telegram_dependent": counts["TELEGRAM_DEPENDENT"] + counts["TELEGRAM_MODULE"],
    }
    blockers = []
    critical = {"systems/combat_system.py", "systems/player_system.py", "systems/reward_system.py", "systems/equipment_system.py"}
    for rel in missing:
        if rel in critical:
            blockers.append({"code": "missing_critical_module", "message": rel})
    for item in syntax_errors:
        blockers.append({"code": "syntax_error", "message": f"{item['module']}: {item['error']}"})
    if not all_functions:
        blockers.append({"code": "no_functions", "message": "No functions analyzed"})

    result = {
        "version": VERSION,
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "verdict": "FAIL" if blockers else "PASS",
        "blockers": blockers,
        "missing_modules": missing,
        "syntax_errors": syntax_errors,
        "summary": summary,
        "policies": {
            "pvp_deferred": True,
            "inventory_capacity_baseline": 40,
            "inventory_capacity_experiment": 60,
            "inventory_reserve_slots": 2,
            "hp_potion_threshold": 0.30,
            "mp_potion_threshold": 0.25,
            "repair_threshold_strictly_below": 10,
            "mob_level_delta": [-1, 0, 1],
            "energy_max": 40,
            "energy_regen_minutes": 5,
            "profiles": {"casual": "18:00-21:00", "regular": "17:00-23:00", "hardcore": "09:00-23:00"},
        },
        "modules": modules,
        "database_files_before": before,
    }

    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)
    (root / "MD").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md").write_text(build_architecture_md(result), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md").write_text(build_policy_md(), encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "MD/SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md").write_text(roadmap(result), encoding="utf-8")

    after = {name: sha(root / name) for name in ("game.db", "game.db-wal")}
    strict_unchanged = before == after
    result["database_files_after"] = after
    result["database_files_unchanged"] = strict_unchanged
    if not strict_unchanged:
        result["verdict"] = "FAIL"
        result["blockers"].append({"code": "database_changed", "message": "game.db or WAL changed during AST-only audit"})
    write_json(root / "SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json", result)

    output_paths = [root / x for x in OUTPUTS[:-1]]
    manifest_lines = [
        f"version={VERSION}",
        f"generated_at={result['generated_at']}",
        f"verdict={result['verdict']}",
        f"functions_analyzed={summary['functions']}",
        f"pure_candidates={summary['pure_candidates']}",
        f"adapter_required={summary['adapter_required']}",
        f"rng_injection_required={summary['rng_injection_required']}",
        f"clock_injection_required={summary['clock_injection_required']}",
        f"database_files_unchanged={str(strict_unchanged).lower()}",
        "pvp_deferred=true",
        "inventory_capacity_baseline=40",
        "inventory_capacity_experiment=60",
    ]
    for path in output_paths:
        info = sha(path)
        manifest_lines.append(f"file={path.relative_to(root)}|size={info['size']}|sha256={info['sha256']}")
    manifest_path = root / OUTPUTS[-1]
    manifest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest_path.write_text("\n".join(manifest_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print("[OK] ROM simulation architecture and purity audit")
    print(f"- verdict: {result['verdict']}")
    print(f"- modules: {summary['modules_found']}/{summary['modules_expected']}")
    print(f"- functions analyzed: {summary['functions']}")
    print(f"- pure candidates: {summary['pure_candidates']}")
    print(f"- adapter required: {summary['adapter_required']}")
    print(f"- seeded RNG injection required: {summary['rng_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- SimulationClock injection required: {summary['clock_injection_required']}")
    print(f"- game.db/WAL unchanged: {'YES' if strict_unchanged else 'NO'}")
    print("- PvP: DEFERRED")
    print("- inventory scenarios: 40 baseline / 60 experiment")
    print("- report: MD\\SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md")
    print("- policy: MD\\SIMULATION_MVP_POLICY_SPECIFICATION.md")
    print("- roadmap: MD\\SIMULATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md")
    print("- matrix: SIMULATION_CALLABILITY_MATRIX.json")
    if result["blockers"]:
        for finding in result["blockers"]:
            print(f"  [BLOCKER] {finding['code']}: {finding['message']}")
    if result["verdict"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(2)

1. **13.1 Simulation foundation**: dataclasses/models, SimulationState, SimulationClock, seeded RNG, config, metrics, report serialization.
2. **13.2 Canonical pure rules and parity layer**: extract/wrap damage, crit, dodge, reward, repair, refine, compatibility and capacity rules; parity tests against production.
3. **13.3 Exact single-battle PvE engine**: normal/elite/boss, skills, cooldowns, class resources, potions, durability, deterministic seeds.
4. **13.4 Drop and inventory simulation**: central drop system, stack plans, 40/60 capacity, lost loot, city return, sell rules.
5. **13.5 Behavior policy engine**: equipment score, 1H/2H comparison, potion/repair/mob/skill policies, rune insertion/fusion/refine.
6. **13.6 Progression MVP**: level path and progress simulation, active windows, energy, regen, contracts, daily, guild contribution.
7. **13.7 Analytics and comparison**: PvE class balance, progression walls, loot acquisition, rune completion, 40-vs-60 capacity.
8. **13.8 Economy and population**: inflation, guild cohorts, lifecycle checkpoints, FAST-mode calibration against EXACT.
9. **13.9 RNG and patch regression**: baseline/current snapshots, same-seed comparison, lucky/average/unlucky percentiles.

## Deferred

- `systems/pvp_simulator.py`, `/dev_pvp`, `/dev_pvp_all` until production PvP exists.
- Player-facing trade history and PvP implementation are outside this analytics stage.

## Quality gates for every stage

- Real `game.db` SHA-256 unchanged.
- No real user, inventory or guild mutations.
- Seed and config fingerprint recorded.
- Own smoke test plus core regression suite.
- Exact behavior parity tests where a production rule is reused.
- Manual game check only for Telegram DEV handler/UX stages.

def structural_contracts():
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS,
        get_allowed_equipment_stats,
        validate_equipment_stat_policy,
    )
    import db_modules.generated_equipment as canonical
    import db_modules.shop as shop
    from systems import dynamic_equipment_system as compatibility

    classes = {"warrior", "knight", "scout", "rogue", "mage", "priest"}
    assert validate_equipment_stat_policy() == ()
    assert set(CLASS_STAT_WEIGHTS) == classes
    assert set(CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES) == classes
    assert CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES == {
        "mage": "cloth", "priest": "cloth", "scout": "leather",
        "rogue": "leather", "warrior": "chain", "knight": "plate",
    }
    assert get_allowed_equipment_stats("knight", "off_hand", item_subtype="shield") == ("sta", "str")
    assert set(get_allowed_equipment_stats("warrior", "jewelry")) <= {"str", "dex", "sta"}
    assert set(get_allowed_equipment_stats("mage", "jewelry")) <= {"int", "wis", "sta"}
    assert CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES["scout"] == ("bow_2h", "crossbow_2h")
    assert CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES["scout"] == ()

    delegates = (
        "add_primary_stat_to_stats", "add_stat_value",
        "apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats",
        "apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats",
        "clear_primary_stat_bonuses", "generate_dynamic_equipment_stats",
        "get_dynamic_armor_name", "get_dynamic_sell_price",
        "get_dynamic_stat_value", "get_dynamic_weapon_name",
        "get_existing_primary_stat_budget", "get_profile_for_generated_item",
        "get_random_main_hand_profile", "get_random_off_hand_profile",
        "init_dynamic_equipment_system", "normalize_equipment_restriction_value",
        "pick_weighted_stat",
    )
    for name in delegates:
        assert inspect.signature(getattr(canonical, name)) == inspect.signature(getattr(compatibility, name))

    dynamic_source = (ROOT / "systems/dynamic_equipment_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    shop_source = (ROOT / "db_modules/shop.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    generator_source = (ROOT / "db_modules/generated_equipment.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    ast.parse(dynamic_source)
    ast.parse(shop_source)
    ast.parse(generator_source)
    assert "from systems.dynamic_equipment_system import generate_equipment_item" not in shop_source
    assert "redistribute_primary_stat_budget(" in shop_source
    assert generator_source.count("redistribute_primary_stat_budget(") == 2
    assert "systems.dynamic_equipment_system" not in generator_source
    for forbidden in ("sqlite3", "cursor", "conn", "random.", "create_generated_equipment_item"):
        assert forbidden not in dynamic_source

    offers = shop.generate_class_shop_equipment("priest", 8)
    assert offers and all(row["target_class"] == "priest" for row in offers)
    assert callable(shop.populate_class_shop_for_user)

    return {
        "classes": sorted(classes),
        "armor_types": dict(CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES),
        "knight_shield": list(get_allowed_equipment_stats("knight", "off_hand", item_subtype="shield")),
        "delegated_functions": len(delegates),
        "legacy_missing_symbol_removed": True,
        "canonical_item_creation_owner": "db_modules/generated_equipment.py",
        "canonical_policy_owner": "data/equipment_stat_policy.py",
        "thin_compatibility_module": "systems/dynamic_equipment_system.py",
    }
